subject: Quarterly readiness: forecast triage & account-by-account digest
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Apr 2028 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Quarterly readiness: forecast triage & account-by-account digest

Team —

We need a concise, account-by-account digest for the leadership QBR prep deck. Can each of you send an updated line for your owned deals below by EOD tomorrow (Apr 10) so I can consolidate into the exec packet? Keep it tight (2–4 bullets per account):

- ARR/ACV baseline and updated forecast for the quarter
- Confidence (green / yellow / red) + 1 sentence rationale
- Top 2 open blockers and next-step owner + ETA
- Any planned pricing/credit asks or procurement friction

Accounts I care about for the deck: Avery Labs (renewal + expansion), Beacon Health (new pilot), NimbusAI (proof-of-value). If you have supporting one-pagers, attach them here (PDF/XLXs preferred).

I pulled last quarter's briefs into the Drive folder linked below — use that as the template. After you send your lines I'll stitch a one-slide summary per account for leadership.

Thanks — concise and prioritized.

Hannah Schmitt
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none in this message

Related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0BzQ-example-Quarterly-Readiness

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 9 Apr 2028 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarterly readiness: forecast triage & account-by-account digest

Hannah —

Draft lines below (pulling from account brief attached). I'll push a clean spreadsheet by midday tomorrow.

Avery Labs — forecast 4/30: $1.1M ARR renewal + $250k expansion (net +$250k this quarter). Confidence: Yellow — procurement has asked for additional SOC evidence; AM has legal redlines in flight.
- Blocker 1: Procurement SOC checklist — Owner: Laura Bennett — ETA: 4/14
- Blocker 2: Billing terms negotiation (term length/entitlement) — Owner: Hannah Schmitt — ETA: 4/17
- Pricing ask: Customer requested 10% promotional credit over first 3 months (negotiable)

Beacon Health — pilot (new) estimate $90k ACV; Confidence: Green
- Blocker: Data ingress statement required from Security — Owner: Karthik Iyer — ETA: 4/12

NimbusAI — PoC ongoing, forecast $40k this quarter (low confidence)
- Blocker: Latency benchmarks pending — Owner: Aditya Rao — ETA: 4/16

I attached the Avery one-pager for the QBR slide: AveryLabs_account-brief_v3.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB). Also exporting an account summary workbook: BeaconHealth_account-summary.xlsx (XLSX, 220KB).

—Laura
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Adding a couple quick tacticals on Beacon Health and Avery: 

- Beacon Health: we've cleared initial security questionnaire; recommend a phased success metric (week 2 ingest validation) to reduce runway risk. I'll attach the SOW stub in the consolidated drive.

- Avery Labs: procurement signal is soft — suggest we hold on granting any standing credit until we get a signed PO. If leadership wants to accelerate, propose a one-time 7.5% limited credit (14 days to sign). That keeps runway math intact while giving them a bridge.

HubSpot note: HubSpot deal DL-7291 has been updated with Laura's numbers (see link).

—Karthik
Principal Solutions Engineer

Hannah / Laura —

Thanks for the update and for pulling the one-pager together. Procurement is reviewing the SOC checklist now; legal asked us to return a couple of redline points on the SOW, so we expect a brief delay. Draft PO attached (Avery_PO_draft.docx). Our target remains to finalize by April 18, but procurement may ask for an extra week if they escalate to their vendor security team.

Two quick clarifications for the QBR slide: 
1) The expansion is for the Insights module (approx $250k new ARR) and will require a short integration window — our engineers will need API keys by May 3.
2) Requesting visibility on support SLA options if we commit to the expansion — can your team include the SLA matrix in the next packet?

Sarah Miller
VP, IT & Procurement
Avery Labs

Attachment: Avery_PO_draft.docx (DOCX, 48KB)

Thanks everyone — consolidated notes below (this is what I will present to the execs unless I hear corrections by 11am PT tomorrow):

Avery Labs (DL-7291) — Slide: Renewal + Expansion (NET +$250k this quarter); Forecast 4/30 = $1.35M
- Confidence: Yellow 
- Key open items:
  • Procurement SOC checklist (Laura) — ETA 4/14
  • Billing terms & credit ask (Hannah) — action: finalize credit position; recommended cap 7.5% one-time if PO signed by 4/23 — ETA 4/17
  • Integration request: API keys needed by 5/03 (owner: Engineering GTM, Marcus Lin)
- Attachments for slide: AveryLabs_account-brief_v3.pdf; Avery_PO_draft.docx

Beacon Health — Slide: Pilot (ACV $90k) — Confidence: Green
- Action: Karthik to deliver SOW stub and phased metrics doc by 4/12

NimbusAI — Slide: PoC (low confidence) — Forecast $40k
- Action: Aditya to run latency validation and push results by 4/16

Next steps / owners: consolidated spreadsheet + slideone-pager will be in the Drive by 9am PT Apr 10. If you need to escalate any changes to numbers or to the recommended credit cap, please reply-all with the rationale and supporting doc.

I'll include the SLA matrix as requested for Avery's slide — Marcus, can you confirm SLA options by tomorrow?

Hannah
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: AveryLabs_account-brief_v3.pdf, BeaconHealth_account-summary.xlsx, Avery_PO_draft.docx
